# RopeConstraint

- Inherits [`Constraint`](constraint.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("RopeConstraint")`

Two attachments that can be no further apart than `Length`, and as close as they like: a rope, a chain, a leash. Slack, it does nothing.

With the winch on, `Length` itself moves towards `WinchTarget` at `WinchSpeed` -- a crane taking in cable -- and stalls when that would need more than `WinchForce`.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

| `Length` | `number` | `5` | read/write | The most the two ends may be apart, in metres. The winch changes it. |
| `Thickness` | `number` | `0.1` | read/write | How thick that line is, in metres. |
| `WinchEnabled` | `boolean` | `false` | read/write | Whether the winch is working `Length` towards `WinchTarget`. |
